notes: Build101 orchestrates requests that require CODE + DATABASE under one sanitized parent Change Transaction without claiming distributed ACID semantics. The DATABASE ticket/schema/risk is prepared first without executing SQL; the CODE leg is planned and then runs with a session-local forceHumanApproval barrier so Guided/Autonomous global settings cannot auto-cross the mixed boundary. CODE must complete before DATABASE becomes eligible for its own explicit human approval. Raw SQL remains ephemeral only and rehydration requires the caller to re-supply SQL whose SHA-256 must match the existing ticket. Database ambiguous outcomes never auto-retry; if database execution fails after a code commit, recovery is explicitly delegated to Build99 Git Transaction Revert. Existing standalone CODE Guided Autonomy and standalone DATABASE Plan-Review-Run behavior remain unchanged. This package metadata does not authorize OTA, GitHub Release, store publication or merge to main.
